title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
summary: AI is forcing companies to patch their systems faster as attackers race to exploit newly discovered vulnerabilities. Welcome to internet outage hell.
llm_summary: AI is accelerating the pace at which new software flaws are discovered, forcing companies to roll out patches at record speed. Meanwhile, cyber‑attackers are racing to weaponize those same vulnerabilities before they’re fixed, leading to a surge in service disruptions. The result? A wave of internet outages that’s only just beginning.
